note.en: The Serpent Sun (Imbalance; Sapient Metal splinter) has '?' rather than a die face. Its House begins appearing only after the first Punishment is killed; consult the Chess Board rules. No d12 outcome is replaced or invented here.
note.es: Serpent Sun (Imbalance; Sapient Metal splinter) tiene '?' en vez de una cara del dado. Su Casa empieza a aparecer solo después de matar al primer Castigo; consultar el Tablero de Ajedrez. Aquí no se sustituye ni inventa una cara del d12.

The Ram (Anger).en: Ultimate Weapon component: Dragon Fire. The Punishment's armor and weapons are loot only if it is defeated (pp. 113–114).
The Ram (Anger).es: Componente del Arma Definitiva: Dragon Fire. La armadura y las armas del Castigo solo se obtienen si es derrotado (pp. 113–114).
